title: Verify: Manifest loader missing-file and malformed-input unit tests
summary: Unit tests for loadManifestFile using temp dirs.
description: Test loadManifestFile with temporary directories so no real asset tree is needed.
acceptance_criteria: Given all files present, when loaded, then ok true
Given a missing file, when loaded, then an issue at assets.0.path
Given absent or invalid JSON, when loaded, then ok false without throwing

steps.action: In a mkdtempSync dir write manifest.json with one image asset (path 'a.svg', 10x10) and assert ok:false with path 'assets.0.path' before creating a.svg; create a.svg and assert ok:true; assert a nonexistent manifest path and a file containing 'not json' return ok:false with path 'manifest' and expect(() => ...).not.toThrow().
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestLoader.test.ts
